It physically hurts to sit next to her and act like nothing happened, and I can't even solve a single quantitative aptitude mock test because my chest feels so tight. But if I don't agree to this, she will leave completely, and I'd rather suffer through this friendship than have her disappear.

She left me during the midterms because she said my anxiety was draining her. I know I messed up by constantly venting about my backlogs and how my parents are comparing my package with my cousin's. If I can just clear this FAANG interview next week and show her the offer letter, she’ll come back, right? I just need her to wait. I've been spamming her texts showing her my LeetCode progress to prove I'm changing. I can't study for the DSA lab tomorrow because my hands are shaking, but I have to fix this.

He told me we're over because long distance isn't working with his heavy tech schedule. I'm literally ready to tank my CGPA and transfer to a lower-tier college in his city just to be near him. My dad took a huge loan for my engineering tuition here, but none of it matters if he's not in my life. I keep mailing him these elaborate plans of how I can balance both if he just gives me another chance. He hasn't replied, but he's just busy with his micro-projects, he doesn't actually mean it's over.

We built our whole dream of getting placed in the same city, but then the grade sheets came out and my CGPA plummeted to 6.2. She ghosted me right after the viva exams. I keep telling myself she's just shocked and trying to give me space to study. I’ve sent her five emails outlining my plan to crack the gate exam or get my papers re-evaluated so we can still move together. If I can just pull my grades up by 1 point, she'll realize I'm not a loser and we'll go back to how we were.

My friends keep asking why she isn't sitting with me during the DBMS lectures anymore, and I just laugh and say she’s busy with her club projects. We broke up two weeks ago, but I know she didn't mean it—she was just stressed about her failed coding runs. I've been tracking her schedule so I can 'bump' into her near the lab and show her I bought the concert tickets she wanted. If I can just show her I'm still the same guy who comforted her during board exams, she’ll drop this cold behavior.

He broke up with me because he said my depression during this mock-test series was dragging him down. I told him I'll stop going to therapy and stop crying, I swear I can just force myself to be happy if he stays. I'm sitting in the library trying to solve these mock tests but all I can do is drafts of texts begging him to just let me sit next to him in silence. If I promise to never bring up my academic anxiety again, why can't we just pretend this week never happened?

She blocked me on WhatsApp right before the TCS Digital interviews started. She said we are too different and the stress is killing her, but I know she’s just overwhelmed with her own backlogs. I literally coded for 14 hours straight today thinking if I can just land a 12 LPA offer next month, I can show her parents we have a future and she’ll unblock me. If I just fix my CGPA and call her from a new number to explain the plan, she has to understand, right? We didn't actually break up, she's just scared.

He hasn’t replied to my texts in three weeks, just views my Instagram stories. I’ve been sitting in the compiler lab doing his entire Object-Oriented Programming assignment for him, thinking that when I email it to him with a sweet note about his upcoming viva, he’ll realize how much I care and call me. It’s just exam stress making him distant; once semester exams end, we will go back to how we were in first year. He can't just throw away two years over a bad month, I just need to make his life easier right now.

My girlfriend broke up with me yesterday because she got placed in Bangalore and I'm still stuck trying to clear my backlogs here. I didn’t even cry because I know it’s not real; she’s just stressed about the relocation. I’ve already started looking for off-campus support roles in Bangalore and I'm planning to mail my resume to companies there, even if it means dropping my GATE preparation. Once I secure any random job in her city, she will see we don’t have to end, and everything will go back to normal.

She got into an IIT and told me we are on different wavelengths now and should stop talking. But I know she still loves me; she’s just overwhelmed by her new peers and the crazy GPA curve there. I’ve decided to buy the most expensive GATE coaching module tonight and study 18 hours a day, sleeping only 4 hours, so I can crack IIT Bombay next year. When she sees my rank card, she’ll realize I’m still the same smart guy she fell for, and we’ll laugh about this break phase.

He left me because he said I'm always depressed about my code bugs and have no social life. He’s dating someone else now, but it’s clearly a rebound because he was lonely during the summer break. I’m spending every single night LeetCoding until 4 AM so I can land a 40 LPA Microsoft package in the upcoming day-1 placement drive. When he sees my LinkedIn update about the offer, he will regret leaving and realize I was just building our future, and he'll come running back to me.

We broke up last week and my coding lab is a complete mess. I keep staring at our old WhatsApp chat while trying to debug this tree traversal code. I literally told myself if I can just crack this placement interview next month and get a 12 LPA offer, they'll realize I'm not a failure and come back. I'm literally planning to text them the moment I clear the first round. Is it crazy to think we can fix this if I just fix my life first?

She said she needs space because our board prep and JEE coaching is too much, but she didn't mean a real breakup, right? I've been grinding 14 hours a day thinking that once mock tests are over, everything will go back to how it was in 11th grade. I even bought two tickets for that music festival in December because there's no way we aren't together by then. I can't even focus on my physics formulas because I'm busy scripting our reunion in my head.

I keep telling myself that if I delete all my social media and focus entirely on clearing my three backlogs this semester, the universe will reward me by making him text me. Every time my phone buzzes during a lecture, my heart jumps thinking it's him saying he made a mistake. I'm literally bargaining with God, saying I'll give up my college trip if I can just have one normal conversation with him. I feel like I'm losing my mind trying to control things I can't.

My friends saw her talking to someone else at the college fest, but I know she's just doing it to make me jealous. We spent two years studying together in the library, she can't just throw that away for some random guy. I'm planning to sit in our usual library spot tomorrow and study for the DSA viva, hoping she'll walk past and see me there. I just need to show her I'm still the same guy who helped her clear her math exams.

He broke up with me saying I'm too negative, and honestly, he's right—I've been a wreck since I failed my project evaluations. I've started reading self-help books and I'm forcing myself to smile in front of the mirror every morning before classes. If I can prove to him that I'm happy and successful now, he'll definitely want to get back together. I just need to pretend nothing is wrong and act like the perfect, stress-free version of myself until he notices.

She left me last night because she said my anxiety is too much to handle. I know I screwed up during my midterms, I was constantly complaining about my DSA lab and how my CGPA dropped to 6.8. If I can just get into this off-campus placement next week, I can prove to her that I'm not a loser. I keep texting her screenshots of my LeetCode streak to show I'm changing. She hasn't replied, but she's probably just busy with her own project evaluations, right? She wouldn't just throw away two years over a bad month.

My boyfriend broke up with me because my parents are constantly comparing his family's package with mine and I let the pressure get to me. I keep calling him, telling him that once I clear my active backlogs, my parents will stop lecturing us and we can go back to how we were in first year. He blocked my number, but I know it's just a temporary reaction because he's stressed about the TCS mock tests. I'm planning to wait outside his hostel tomorrow with his favorite coffee so we can just talk and undo this.

We were supposed to move to Bangalore together after placements. He got placed in a Tier-1 firm and I got stuck with a basic mass recruiter job, and now he says we should 'take a break'. I know he's just scared of long distance and the workload. If I study day and night and crack a switch to a Bangalore-based startup within three months, he'll realize we don't have to break up. I'm currently ignoring my final semester project evaluations just to apply to Bangalore jobs, because if I don't fix this now, there's no point to any of this anyway.

She blocked me on WhatsApp after a huge fight about how I never make time for her because of my CAT coaching and mock tests. I can't accept this is the end. I sent her an email saying I'll skip the next three mock tests and even cancel my coaching enrollment if she just unblocks me for ten minutes. I know she doesn't actually want to leave; she’s just testing to see if I prioritize her over my career. I'm sitting in the library staring at an empty mock test screen, unable to type because I'm just waiting for her email reply.

My girlfriend of four years broke up with me because I failed my GATE exam and my mental health spiraled. I know she still loves me, she's probably just overwhelmed by her own family's academic expectations of her. I'm going to take out a personal student loan to join an elite offline coaching center in Delhi next month, and once I show her the admission receipt, she'll see I'm serious about our future and come back. I can't sleep or study right now, I just keep looking at our old photos, waiting for this nightmare to end.

She blocked me on everything right before the end-sem DSA lab. But I know it's just because she's stressed about her CGPA and that 8-LPA internship interview next week. If I can just clear my backlogs and secure a Day-1 placement, she'll see that I'm serious and come back. I’ve been coding for 14 hours straight, telling myself that once my GitHub green grass looks perfect, she’ll unblock me because we used to dream about cracking FAANG together.

I keep checking his Spotify active status during my midterm prep. He's listening to our playlist, which means he's still thinking of me, right? He said we need a break because of the placement pressure and his parents' expectations about him getting a 20+ LPA job, but I know we'll get back together after graduation. I wrote a whole script to automate checking if he unblocked my WhatsApp so I can text him the moment the placement drive ends.

He broke up with me saying he has to focus on UPSC prep and can't handle a relationship right now. But I know it's not real. If I offer to write his notes, do his mock test analyses, and stop asking to meet, we can still stay together. I literally spent all night yesterday compiling GS syllabus PDFs for him instead of studying for my own end-sems because if I help him crack this, he won't leave me.

She told her friends we are over because my CGPA fell to 6.8 and she needs someone who is 'driven'. But I know she’s just putting on a front because her parents are super strict and she’s stressed about her TCS placement. Once I clear my backlogs this semester and pull my CGPA up to a 7.5, I’ll surprise her outside her library cubicle. It’s just a temporary setback; we’ve planned our whole lives together since our first-year induction.

My boyfriend of three years suddenly said he lost feelings during the mass recruitment drives. I told him it's just the stress of the aptitude tests talking. I've decided to stop studying for my own Infosys interview so I can spend time preparing his resume and mock interviews. If he gets placed first, his stress will go down and he will realize he still loves me, right? It's just the placement season ruining us, not our love.

She broke up with me right before the Day 1 placement interviews started, saying I'm too obsessed with my CGPA and don't have time for her. I can't accept this. I literally coded for 14 hours straight yesterday just so I could get a high-paying FAANG offer and buy her that promise ring she wanted. I texted her a 500-word paragraph saying if she just waits until midterms are over, I'll delete my LeetCode account, drop my project lead role, and spend every weekend with her. She hasn't replied. I'm staring at my compiler error in the DSA lab right now and my hands are shaking. If I just get this 12 LPA offer, she’ll come back, right? She has to.

We were together for three years, through all the backlogs and endless night shifts at the library. Yesterday, he told me he 'lost the spark' because of the distance since he got placed in Bangalore, and he wants to end it. I’m in denial. I spent the last six hours calculating how many DSA questions I need to solve daily to clear an off-campus drive in Bangalore so I can move there next month. I haven't even slept or touched my end-sem prep. If I just show him a flight ticket and a job offer near his PG, he won't leave me, right? He’s just scared of the distance, it’s not that he doesn't love me anymore.

My girlfriend ghosted me a week ago after I failed my third system design mock test. My parents keep asking why she hasn't visited, comparing my miserable 6.5 CGPA with her cousin's 9.2. I keep leaving her voicemails saying I'll change my stream, clear my backlogs, and even let her manage my monthly allowance if she just talks to me. I can't study for my upcoming viva tomorrow. I keep looking at her WhatsApp 'online' status, thinking she's just testing my dedication. If I just pass this viva with an S-grade, she will see I'm worth it and unblock me.

My boyfriend of four years broke up with me over a text because he says my anxiety during the placement season is draining him. I don't believe it's over. I keep editing this shared Google Doc we had for our college project, adding little notes like 'I promise I won't cry during study sessions anymore' and 'I'll stop talking about my package fears.' If I just act completely happy and pretend I'm not stressed about my TCS digital interview, he'll realize I'm not a burden. I can't lose him and my career prospects at the same time. I'm completely numb.

We decided to take a 'break' during the final year project evaluations because we kept arguing, but I know it's a breakup. I can't accept it. I literally spent my entire pocket money buying his favorite mech keyboard and left it outside his hostel door with a note saying I'll write his entire compiler design lab manual for the rest of the semester if he just sits next to me in the library. My friends say I'm losing my self-respect, but they don't get it. I can't face this lonely campus alone. If I can just write his codes and keep him happy, we will go back to how we were in first year.
